run_ACL_training: run the adversarial continual learning training loop across multiple tasks using a config file
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to execute multiple training runs with different random seeds
test_trained_model: test a trained ACL model on all tasks by loading a checkpoint and running inference
run_ACL_with_config: run the ACL experiment by passing a YAML config file via the --config argument
run_ACL_evaluation: run evaluation on a trained model by swapping the shared module and testing across tasks
